t: 2032 — First certified transit hulls service opens: TBM fleets propulsi
title: 2032 — First certified transit hulls service opens: TBM fleets propulsi
definition: 2032 milestone on the Tunnel Boring Transit roadmap.
description:
First certified transit hulls service opens: TBM fleets propulsion carrying paying passengers on transit logistics guideways.

What must be true first: the TBM fleets results have to replicate outside the lab, transit logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and boring speed operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed TBM fleets demonstrations, transit logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting boring speed uptime. When all three flash green, 2032 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (6 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Tunnel Boring Transit
definition: Estimates Tunnel Boring Transit readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Tunnel Boring Transit components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a transit hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Tunnel Boring Transit Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Tunnel Boring Transit operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Tunnel Boring Transit installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 7214 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where TBM fleets monitoring, transit logistics redundancy, or boring speed maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Tunnel Boring Transit Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Tunnel Boring Transit: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Tunnel Boring Transit — transit in networks of bored tunnels.

Phase 1 — Prove (TBM fleets): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (transit logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (boring speed): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (station caverns): transit hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and cities-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
